review_description: Everything was done for me the moment I made my decision. Application to Synergy then Western Power. Installers were punctual, polite, explained everything I needed to know. Yes they did organise the grid connection after the install. Customer service was excellent.

Peter was brilliant with answering my questions but not pushy at all.  I ordered the system on the Friday, he was around in the Tuesday putting up brackets and wiring and returned on the Saturday to install the complete system.

Peter from Pelican Electrical responded honestly to all my questions and gave me the information without trying to "sell" me.  He is the "salesperson and the installer" and recommened my system as the one that he put on his roof after having done all the research himself.  He didn't phone me and pester me but came across as an honest and upfront guy.  I went with my gut feeling and am glad I did.  By his own admission, he doesn't employ sales techniques, but their was an abundance of honesty.I have asked him to "please" use me as testimonial point as I can't sing his praises highly enough.I thank you for pointing me in his direction from the start.
